dialogue.ja: これがインテリジェンスです。

dialogue.en: This is the intelligence.

dialogue.local: Better per watt for a given power of data center, the more throughput, the more tokens you can produce.
dialogue.en: Better per watt for a given power of data center, the more throughput, the more tokens you can produce.

dialogue.en: On this side is cost.

dialogue.zh: 請注意，NVIDIA 擁有世界最高的效能。

dialogue.en: Notice, NVIDIA is the highest performance in the world.

dialogue.zh: 沒有人會對此感到驚訝。
dialogue.ja: 誰もそれに驚かないでしょう。
dialogue.local: Nobody would be surprised by that.
dialogue.en: Nobody would be surprised by that.

dialogue.text: They would be surprised by the fact that in one generation, whereas Moore's law would have given us through transistors, 50% two times.
dialogue.zh: 但他們會驚訝於一代之間，摩爾定律預期晶體管性能提升約50%，翻倍兩次。

dialogue.en: They would be surprised by the fact that in one generation, whereas Moore's law would have given us through transistors, 50% two times.

dialogue.zh: 摩爾定律大約會帶來1.5倍的性能提升。

dialogue.local: Moore's law would probably give us one and a half times more performance.
dialogue.en: Moore's law would probably give us one and a half times more performance.

dialogue.text: You would have expected from Hopper H200, one and a half times higher.
dialogue.zh: 你會預期 Hopper H200 的性能提升約1.5倍。
dialogue.ja: Hopper H200からは1.5倍の性能向上が期待されていました。
dialogue.local: You would have expected from Hopper H200, one and a half times higher.
dialogue.en: You would have expected from Hopper H200, one and a half times higher.

dialogue.text: Nobody would have expected 35 times higher.
dialogue.zh: 沒有人會預期會有35倍的提升。
dialogue.ja: 誰も35倍の性能向上を予想していませんでした。
dialogue.local: Nobody would have expected 35 times higher.
dialogue.en: Nobody would have expected 35 times higher.

dialogue.text: I said, last year, at this time, that NVIDIA's Grace Blackwell, Enveeeling 72, was 35 times per watt.
dialogue.zh: 我去年這個時候說過，NVIDIA 的 Grace Blackwell，Enveeeling 72，每瓦效能提升了35倍。
dialogue.ja: 私は昨年の今頃、NVIDIAのGrace Blackwell、Enveeeling 72がワットあたり35倍の性能を持つと言いました。
dialogue.local: I said, last year, at this time, that NVIDIA's Grace Blackwell, Enveeeling 72, was 35 times per watt.
dialogue.en: I said, last year, at this time, that NVIDIA's Grace Blackwell, Enveeeling 72, was 35 times per watt.

dialogue.text: Nobody believed me.
dialogue.zh: 沒有人相信我。
dialogue.ja: 誰も私を信じませんでした。

dialogue.en: Nobody believed me.

dialogue.text: And then, semi-analysis came out.
dialogue.zh: 後來，半導體分析報告出來了。
dialogue.ja: そして、半導体分析が発表されました。
dialogue.local: And then, semi-analysis came out.
dialogue.en: And then, semi-analysis came out.

dialogue.text: And Dylan Patel had a quote.

dialogue.local: And Dylan Patel had a quote.
dialogue.en: And Dylan Patel had a quote.

dialogue.text: He accused me of sandbagging.
dialogue.zh: 他指責我低估了性能。
dialogue.ja: 彼は私が性能を過小評価していると非難しました。
dialogue.local: He accused me of sandbagging.
dialogue.en: He accused me of sandbagging.

dialogue.text: He says, gents and sandbagged.
dialogue.zh: 他說，實際上是50倍。
dialogue.ja: 彼は実際には50倍だと言いました。
dialogue.local: He says, gents and sandbagged.
dialogue.en: He says, gents and sandbagged.

dialogue.text: It's actually 50 times.
dialogue.zh: 確實是50倍。
dialogue.ja: 実際には50倍です。
dialogue.local: It's actually 50 times.
dialogue.en: It's actually 50 times.

dialogue.text: And he's not wrong.
dialogue.zh: 他說得沒錯。
dialogue.ja: 彼は間違っていません。
dialogue.local: And he's not wrong.
dialogue.en: And he's not wrong.

dialogue.text: And so, our cost per token. Yeah. Our cost per token is the lowest in the world you can't beat it.
dialogue.zh: 所以，我們的每個代幣成本是世界最低，無人能及。
dialogue.ja: したがって、私たちのトークンあたりのコストは世界で最も低く、誰も勝てません。
dialogue.local: And so, our cost per token. Yeah. Our cost per token is the lowest in the world you can't beat it.
dialogue.en: And so, our cost per token. Yeah. Our cost per token is the lowest in the world you can't beat it.

dialogue.text: I've said before, if you have the wrong architecture, even if it's free, it's not cheap enough.
dialogue.zh: 我之前說過，如果架構錯誤，即使免費也不夠便宜。
dialogue.ja: 以前にも言いましたが、間違ったアーキテクチャでは、無料でも十分に安くはありません。
dialogue.local: I've said before, if you have the wrong architecture, even if it's free, it's not cheap enough.
dialogue.en: I've said before, if you have the wrong architecture, even if it's free, it's not cheap enough.

dialogue.text: And the reason for that is because no matter what happens, you still have to build a gigawatt data center.
dialogue.zh: 原因是無論如何，你仍然必須建造一個千兆瓦級的數據中心。
dialogue.ja: その理由は、何があってもギガワット級のデータセンターを建設しなければならないからです。
dialogue.local: And the reason for that is because no matter what happens, you still have to build a gigawatt data center.
dialogue.en: And the reason for that is because no matter what happens, you still have to build a gigawatt data center.

dialogue.text: You still have to build a gigawatt factory.
dialogue.zh: 你仍然必須建造一個千兆瓦工廠。
dialogue.ja: ギガワット工場を建設しなければなりません。
dialogue.local: You still have to build a gigawatt factory.
dialogue.en: You still have to build a gigawatt factory.

dialogue.text: And that gigawatt factory, for 15 years, amortized across, that gigawatt factory is about $40 billion.
dialogue.zh: 這個千兆瓦工廠的攤銷成本約為400億美元，分攤15年。
dialogue.ja: そのギガワット工場は15年間で償却され、約400億ドルの費用がかかります。
dialogue.local: And that gigawatt factory, for 15 years, amortized across, that gigawatt factory is about $40 billion.
dialogue.en: And that gigawatt factory, for 15 years, amortized across, that gigawatt factory is about $40 billion.

dialogue.text: Even when you put nothing on, it's $40 billion in.
dialogue.zh: 即使什麼都不放，成本也是400億美元。
dialogue.ja: 何も置かなくても400億ドルのコストがかかります。
dialogue.local: Even when you put nothing on, it's $40 billion in.
dialogue.en: Even when you put nothing on, it's $40 billion in.

dialogue.text: You better make, for darn sure, you put the best computer system on that thing so that you could have the best token cost.
dialogue.zh: 你最好確保在那上面放置最好的電腦系統，才能擁有最低的代幣成本。
dialogue.ja: 最高のトークンコストを得るために、最高のコンピューターシステムを設置することが重要です。
dialogue.local: You better make, for darn sure, you put the best computer system on that thing so that you could have the best token cost.
dialogue.en: You better make, for darn sure, you put the best computer system on that thing so that you could have the best token cost.

dialogue.text: And video's token cost is world class, basically untouchable at the moment.
dialogue.zh: 而NVIDIA的代幣成本是世界級的，目前基本無人能及。
dialogue.ja: NVIDIAのトークンコストは世界クラスで、現時点ではほぼ無敵です。
dialogue.local: And video's token cost is world class, basically untouchable at the moment.
dialogue.en: And video's token cost is world class, basically untouchable at the moment.

dialogue.text: And the reason that's true is because of extreme code design.
dialogue.zh: 這是因為極致的程式碼設計。
dialogue.ja: それが可能なのは、極限のコード設計のおかげです。
dialogue.local: And the reason that's true is because of extreme code design.
dialogue.en: And the reason that's true is because of extreme code design.

dialogue.text: And so, I'm very happy that he named us... There was a monkey king, token king.
dialogue.zh: 所以，我很高興他稱我們為猴王、代幣王。
dialogue.ja: だから、彼が私たちをモンキーキング、トークンキングと呼んでくれてとても嬉しいです。
dialogue.local: And so, I'm very happy that he named us... There was a monkey king, token king.
dialogue.en: And so, I'm very happy that he named us... There was a monkey king, token king.

dialogue.text: Well, we take all of our software, as I told you, we vertically integrate, but we horizontally open.
dialogue.zh: 我們將所有軟體垂直整合，同時橫向開放。
dialogue.ja: 私たちはすべてのソフトウェアを垂直統合しつつ、水平にオープンにしています。
dialogue.local: Well, we take all of our software, as I told you, we vertically integrate, but we horizontally open.
dialogue.en: Well, we take all of our software, as I told you, we vertically integrate, but we horizontally open.

dialogue.text: We're vertical integration, horizontal open.
dialogue.zh: 我們是垂直整合，水平開放。
dialogue.ja: 垂直統合でありながら、水平にオープンです。
dialogue.local: We're vertical integration, horizontal open.
dialogue.en: We're vertical integration, horizontal open.

dialogue.zh: 我們整合所有軟體和技術。
dialogue.ja: すべてのソフトウェアと技術を統合しています。
dialogue.local: We integrate all of our software and all of our technology.
dialogue.en: We integrate all of our software and all of our technology.

dialogue.ja: しかし、それをパッケージ化して世界の推論サービスプロバイダーに統合できます。
dialogue.local: However, we could package it up and integrate it into the world's inference service providers.
dialogue.en: However, we could package it up and integrate it into the world's inference service providers.

dialogue.text: And these companies are growing so fast.
dialogue.zh: 這些公司成長非常迅速。
dialogue.ja: これらの企業は非常に速く成長しています。
dialogue.local: And these companies are growing so fast.
dialogue.en: And these companies are growing so fast.

dialogue.text: They're growing so fast.
dialogue.zh: 他們成長得非常快。
dialogue.ja: 彼らは非常に速く成長しています。
dialogue.local: They're growing so fast.
dialogue.en: They're growing so fast.

dialogue.text: Fireworks, Linus here, together.
dialogue.zh: Fireworks，Linus 在這裡，一起成長。
dialogue.ja: ここにいるFireworks、Linusと一緒に。
dialogue.local: Fireworks, Linus here, together.
dialogue.en: Fireworks, Linus here, together.

dialogue.text: They're just growing so incredibly fast.
dialogue.zh: 他們成長得令人難以置信地快。
dialogue.ja: 彼らは信じられないほど速く成長しています。
dialogue.local: They're just growing so incredibly fast.
dialogue.en: They're just growing so incredibly fast.

dialogue.text: A hundred times in the last year, they are token factories.

dialogue.ja: 昨年だけで100倍に成長し、彼らはトークン工場です。
dialogue.local: A hundred times in the last year, they are token factories.
dialogue.en: A hundred times in the last year, they are token factories.

dialogue.text: And the effectiveness, the performance, and the token cost production capability for their factories is everything to them.

dialogue.ja: 彼らにとって、工場の効率、性能、トークンコストの生産能力がすべてです。
dialogue.local: And the effectiveness, the performance, and the token cost production capability for their factories is everything to them.
dialogue.en: And the effectiveness, the performance, and the token cost production capability for their factories is everything to them.

dialogue.text: And this is what happened.
dialogue.zh: 這就是發生的事情。
dialogue.ja: これが起こったことです。
dialogue.local: And this is what happened.
dialogue.en: And this is what happened.

dialogue.text: This is... We updated their software, same system, and notice their token speeds incredible.
dialogue.zh: 我們更新了他們的軟體，使用相同系統，注意他們的代幣速度驚人。
dialogue.ja: 彼らのソフトウェアを更新し、同じシステムでトークン速度が驚異的に向上しました。
dialogue.local: This is... We updated their software, same system, and notice their token speeds incredible.
dialogue.en: This is... We updated their software, same system, and notice their token speeds incredible.

dialogue.text: So, the difference before and video updated everything and all of our algorithms and software and all the technology that we bring to bear, about 700 tokens per second average went to nearly 5,000, seven times higher.
dialogue.zh: 在更新前後，我們的算法、軟體和技術使代幣速度從約700令牌每秒提升到近5000，增長七倍。
dialogue.ja: アップデート前は平均700トークン/秒でしたが、すべてのアルゴリズムとソフトウェアを更新した結果、約7倍の5000トークン/秒になりました。
dialogue.local: So, the difference before and video updated everything and all of our algorithms and software and all the technology that we bring to bear, about 700 tokens per second average went to nearly 5,000, seven times higher.
dialogue.en: So, the difference before and video updated everything and all of our algorithms and software and all the technology that we bring to bear, about 700 tokens per second average went to nearly 5,000, seven times higher.

dialogue.text: And so, this is the incredible power of extreme code design.
dialogue.zh: 這就是極致程式碼設計的驚人威力。
dialogue.ja: これが極限のコード設計の驚異的な力です。
dialogue.local: And so, this is the incredible power of extreme code design.
dialogue.en: And so, this is the incredible power of extreme code design.

dialogue.text: I mentioned earlier the importance of factories.

dialogue.ja: 先ほど工場の重要性について言及しました。
dialogue.local: I mentioned earlier the importance of factories.

dialogue.text: This is the importance of factory.
dialogue.zh: 這就是工廠的重要性。
dialogue.ja: これが工場の重要性です。
dialogue.local: This is the importance of factory.
dialogue.en: This is the importance of factory.

dialogue.text: It used to be a data center for files.
dialogue.zh: 過去是用來存放檔案的數據中心。
dialogue.ja: かつてはファイルのためのデータセンターでした。
dialogue.local: It used to be a data center for files.
dialogue.en: It used to be a data center for files.

dialogue.text: It's now a factory to generate tokens.
dialogue.zh: 現在是用來生成代幣的工廠。
dialogue.ja: 今ではトークンを生成する工場です。
dialogue.local: It's now a factory to generate tokens.
dialogue.en: It's now a factory to generate tokens.

dialogue.text: Your factory is limited no matter what.
dialogue.zh: 無論如何，你的工廠都是有限的。
dialogue.ja: あなたの工場はどんな場合でも制限されています。
dialogue.local: Your factory is limited no matter what.
dialogue.en: Your factory is limited no matter what.

dialogue.text: Everybody is looking for land, power, and shell.
dialogue.zh: 每個人都在尋找土地、電力和機殼。
dialogue.ja: 誰もが土地、電力、シェルを探しています。
dialogue.local: Everybody is looking for land, power, and shell.
dialogue.en: Everybody is looking for land, power, and shell.

dialogue.text: Once you build it, you are power limited.
dialogue.zh: 一旦建造完成，你就受限於電力。
dialogue.ja: 一度建設すると、電力に制限されます。
dialogue.local: Once you build it, you are power limited.
dialogue.en: Once you build it, you are power limited.

dialogue.zh: 在這有限電力的基礎設施中，你必須確保推理效能最佳化，因為推理是你的工作負載，代幣是你的新商品，計算即是你的收入。
dialogue.ja: 電力制限のあるインフラ内で、推論がワークロードであり、トークンが新しいコモディティであり、計算が収益であることを理解し、アーキテクチャを最適化する必要があります。
dialogue.local: Within that power limited infrastructure, you better make for darn sure that your inference, because you know inference is your workload, and tokens is your new commodity that compute is your revenues that you want to make sure that the architecture is as optimized as you can.
dialogue.en: Within that power limited infrastructure, you better make for darn sure that your inference, because you know inference is your workload, and tokens is your new commodity that compute is your revenues that you want to make sure that the architecture is as optimized as you can.

dialogue.text: In the future, every single CSP, every single computer company, every single cloud company, every single AI company, every single company period are going to be thinking about their token factory effectiveness.
dialogue.zh: 未來，每一家雲服務商、電腦公司、雲端公司、AI 公司，甚至所有公司都會關注他們的代幣工廠效能。
dialogue.ja: 将来、すべてのCSP、コンピューター会社、クラウド会社、AI会社、すべての企業がトークン工場の効率を考えるようになります。
dialogue.local: In the future, every single CSP, every single computer company, every single cloud company, every single AI company, every single company period are going to be thinking about their token factory effectiveness.
dialogue.en: In the future, every single CSP, every single computer company, every single cloud company, every single AI company, every single company period are going to be thinking about their token factory effectiveness.

dialogue.text: This is your factory in the future.
dialogue.zh: 這是你未來的工廠。
dialogue.ja: これが未来のあなたの工場です。
dialogue.local: This is your factory in the future.
dialogue.en: This is your factory in the future.

dialogue.text: And the reason why I know that is because everybody in this room is powered by intelligence, and in the future that intelligence will be augmented by tokens.
dialogue.zh: 我知道這點是因為在座每個人都依靠智慧，而未來這智慧將由代幣增強。
dialogue.ja: 私がそう確信するのは、この部屋の全員が知性に支えられており、未来にはその知性がトークンによって強化されるからです。
dialogue.local: And the reason why I know that is because everybody in this room is powered by intelligence, and in the future that intelligence will be augmented by tokens.
dialogue.en: And the reason why I know that is because everybody in this room is powered by intelligence, and in the future that intelligence will be augmented by tokens.
